CVE-2026-44025 is CVE.org state PUBLISHED (cveMetadata.state=PUBLISHED, datePublished 2026-07-08); GHSA-pr7j-96cj-549h withdrawn_at is null. Unauthenticated Monitor Agent HTTP (default bind 0.0.0.0 port 24220) accepts query debug=1 / with_ivars; get_monitor_info then copies plugin instance_variables into /api/plugins.json (and related endpoints). At v1.19.2 (76841666b4e4aade23f0c100a7e048995f7d52c8) build_option sets opts[:with_debug_info] from qs['debug'] and opts[:ivars] from qs['with_ivars'] with no server-side gate; get_monitor_info serializes those ivars. Secrets held in plugin ivars (DB passwords, API keys, cloud credentials) leak to any client that can reach the port.
